items.title: Harold Fannin: Renews chemistry with Sanders in OT loss
items.text:
Fannin caught both his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Two TDs on 20 touches in Week 9
items.text:
McCaffrey rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

items.title: KC Concepcion: Finds end zone for first time
items.text:
Concepcion caught four of six targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints. He added three yards on his only carry.

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Scores rush TD in easy win
items.text:
Johnson rushed six times for 34 yards and a touchdown and returned one kickoff for 29 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Just misses century mark in New Orleans
items.text:
Boston caught six of seven targets for 98 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.
